message.reasoning: We need to evaluate fuel level and mileage. We have tools: get current speed, get outside temperature, etc. But we need fuel level. There's no direct function to get fuel level. We have displayCarStatus with option "fuel". That likely returns fuel status. Also we have estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage(distance). That will evaluate if mileage is enough. So we should call displayCarStatus with option "fuel" to get fuel level. Then call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance 750 miles. Then combine results.
